analysis.headline: Shares Your Data for Marketing
analysis.quote: We may share your personal information with our affiliated and unaffiliated service providers who use that information to help us provide our Products and Services.

analysis.headline: Collects Sensitive Security Data
analysis.quote: In connection with some of our Products and Services, we may collect certain personal information relevant to security threats (e.g., IP addresses, device identifiers, URLs, and other data associated with malicious activity).

analysis.headline: Automated Decisions Affect You
analysis.quote: We may engage in automated decision making, including profiling. Our processing of your personal information will not result in a decision based solely on automated processing that significantly affects you, unless such a decision is necessary as part of a contract we have with you, we have your consent, or we are permitted by law to engage in such automated decision making.

analysis.headline: Your Data Stored Internationally
analysis.quote: Our Company is headquartered in the United States, and we have operations, entities, and service providers in the United States and throughout the world.

analysis.headline: Tracks You Across Sites
analysis.quote: Marketing: The technical storage or access is required to create user profiles to send advertising, or to track the user on a website or across several websites for similar marketing purposes.

analysis.headline: Ignores 'Do Not Track'
analysis.quote: Please note that we do not respond to or honor DNT signals or similar mechanisms transmitted by web browsers.

analysis.headline: Social Media Collects Your Data
analysis.quote: Our Site may contain social media buttons, such as LinkedIn and X, which might include widgets such as the “share this” button or other interactive mini programs. These features may collect your IP address and which page you are visiting on our Sites and may set a cookie to enable the feature to function properly.

analysis.headline: Retains Your Data Indefinitely
analysis.quote: We will keep your personal information we collect as described in this Notice for as long as you use our Products and Services, or for the period necessary to fulfill the purpose(s) for which it was collected, including for the purposes of satisfying any legal, accounting, reporting, or retention requirements, resolving disputes, establishing legal defenses, conducting audits, pursuing legitimate business purposes, enforcing our agreements, and complying with applicable law.
